title: ingCloud, ing and ingLIFE: check the model
html: ingCloud is a separate model, not another spelling of the original ing. KOKUYO dates the ing series to 2017 and the ingCloud launch to December 2025. Do not carry an older ing review's dimensions, controls or awards over to ingCloud. KOKUYO's model and launch history.

title: Buying checks at a glance
html:
Questions to resolve before ordering ingCloud
DecisionWhat to confirm
ModelThe invoice and product code identify ingCloud, not ing or ingLIFE.
HeadrestChoose the required configuration before ordering; see the configuration notes below.
FitCompare the exact drawing with your desk and available floor space.
DeliveryAsk for a quote to your destination, including assembly and return terms.
SupportGet the seller's written warranty coverage and service arrangements.

title: What the design award does and does not establish
html:
KOKUYO's June 2026 announcement distinguishes two awards: Red Dot in Office Furniture and Office Chairs, and Best of the Best in Innovative Design. The reported 96/100 score belongs to the Innovative Design assessment; it is not a Furniblog comfort rating. Read the award announcement.

A design award does not tell you whether the seat fits your legs, whether you like the movement or whether a seller can support the chair in your country.

match: The designer and the design story
title: What to compare during a demonstration
html:
Use your normal working tasks as the comparison: typing with elbows supported, reaching for a mouse and leaning back between tasks. Note whether you can stay close to your desk without raising your shoulders. Compare the same tasks in your current chair rather than relying on a showroom's first impression.

Ask which controls you may adjust and which movements are built into the mechanism. A comfortable demonstration is useful evidence for your own decision, not a guarantee of long-term comfort.

title: Backrest design and desk clearance
html:
KOKUYO describes a hammock-style mesh back without the usual rigid side frames. That is a construction description, not proof that every body shape will find it comfortable. Official product description.

Check the chair at your working height and in its reclined position. A chair that fits beneath a desk while upright can still require additional room behind it when moving.

match: Ergonomics & how it supports the body
title: How triple gliding works
html:
The manufacturer's triple-gliding description refers to movement beneath the seat, at the backrest and at the armrests. KOKUYO combines this with its shaped mesh back under the 3D Ultra Auto-Fit name. Mechanism explanation.

We have not measured pressure distribution or verified that this mechanism improves concentration. Treat the brand's performance language as manufacturer claims, not comparative test results.

title: Controls: armrests, gliding and seat depth
html:
The brochure describes arm height adjustment and inward pivot, with movement at the arm pad. It lists a 70 mm seat-height adjustment and a two-stage seat-gliding control. It describes a flexible front seat edge rather than a seat-depth slider. Official brochure, Function section.

Do not interpret the gliding control as a conventional recline lock without checking the operating instructions. If you specifically require a sliding seat or a particular arm adjustment, have the seller demonstrate it on the exact model.

title: Can a headrest be added later?
html:
The official brochure lists configurations with and without a headrest and says the headrest cannot be retrofitted. It lists 70 mm of headrest adjustment on the equipped version. Headrest and configuration documentation.

Do not buy the headrest-free chair assuming an accessory will convert it later. Ask the seller to put the selected configuration on the order confirmation.

title: Comfort: evidence and limits
html: Furniblog has not conducted a hands-on sitting test of this chair. We do not have our own pressure measurements, long-session comfort scores or durability results. This guide distinguishes documented specifications from questions that need a personal trial or seller confirmation.

match: Who it's for (and who should skip it)
title: When to shortlist ingCloud, and when to wait
html:
Shortlist ingCloud if its movement system is a feature you specifically want to try and you can verify fit, delivery and support. Wait before ordering if your decision depends on an unconfirmed adjustment, an assumed headrest retrofit or an unclear return route.

We have not established a universal height or body-weight range for comfortable use. Ask for the exact model's limits rather than treating an estimated user range as a tested recommendation.

title: Compare the purchase, not just the chair name
html:
Compare configurations using the same questions: required adjustments, desk clearance, delivered cost, trial or return conditions, and who handles service. We have not performed a head-to-head comfort test and do not rank ingCloud above other chairs on that basis.

For another Japanese model, see the Contessa II features and fit guide. If your priority changes from this particular movement system to a different purchase budget, the SIHOO M18 versus Doro C300 comparison explains two other options and their buying checks. Neither is presented as an equivalent replacement for ingCloud.

title: Sizing, fit and configuration checks
html:
The English product page lists width 720 mm, depth 820-1100 mm, height 1230-1300 mm and seat height 425-495 mm. Use the configuration-specific drawing rather than applying those overall dimensions to every version. Published dimensions.

Measure desk clearance and the space available behind the chair. Before paying, request the exact drawing and check whether your preferred working height is possible with your feet supported.

title: GREENGUARD documentation: scope and dates
html:
KOKUYO publishes a GREENGUARD certificate naming ingCloud, certificate 432862-410, issued June 4, 2026 with a stated expiration of February 4, 2027. It concerns chemical emissions under UL 2818. Read the certificate and its limitations.

This document is not a comfort score or a structural durability test. Its stated dates do not rule out later modification or withdrawal; the certificate directs readers to UL's database for authentication. We have not independently authenticated its current status there.

title: Warranty and service questions for overseas buyers
html:
The brochure specifies ten years for the structural frame. That is not a ten-year promise for every component or every international purchase. Published structural-frame warranty note.

Request written answers on coverage for upholstery and moving parts, the party responsible for repairs, shipping charges and exclusions. Use the care instructions supplied with your exact chair; do not assume a general cleaning or lubrication method applies.

title: Price and where to buy outside Japan
html:
KOKUYO's December 3, 2025 launch release identifies KOKUYO Workstyle Shop as a Japanese consumer sales channel. The dated launch announcement does not establish today's stock, price or international shipping.

We have not verified an ingCloud-specific US checkout or an international delivered price. Start with KOKUYO's official product information and ask the seller whether it can supply your destination. The official links here are not affiliate links. Any Amazon search button is a product search, not confirmation that ingCloud is listed or available.

  • Confirm the exact model code and headrest configuration.
  • Get the total price including tax, freight and any import charges.
  • Check delivery access, assembly and damage-reporting terms.
  • Obtain return and warranty-service terms before payment.

title: Verdict: verify fit and the buying route first
html:
ingCloud is worth investigating when its movement approach matches what you want to try. Our recommendation is to verify the configuration, test it when practical, and obtain a complete delivery and support quote before committing. We cannot recommend paying an import premium on the strength of untested comfort claims.

If you cannot confirm a suitable purchase route, keep it on your shortlist rather than treating a generic shopping search as a verified offer.
